  name: {{ name|lower }}

  sha256: fd62d3d6d8fa85145528065fabad4d7cb20f6b2201e71be4081a4e9701a5b330

build:

requirements:
  build:
    - mecab-ko

  license_family: Apache
  license_file: COPYING
  summary: 'MeCab Korean dictionaries'

    - erip
